messages.content: Write CICS COBOL to read a file

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. CICSREAD.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-RECORD.
          05 WS-KEY           PIC X(10).
          05 WS-DATA          PIC X(90).
       01 WS-RESP             PIC S9(8) COMP.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE 'KEY001' TO WS-KEY
           EXEC CICS READ
               FILE('CUSTFILE')
               INTO(WS-RECORD)
               RIDFLD(WS-KEY)
               RESP(WS-RESP)
           END-EXEC
           IF WS-RESP = DFHRESP(NORMAL)
               EXEC CICS SEND TEXT
                   FROM(WS-DATA)
                   LENGTH(90)
               END-EXEC
           END-IF
           EXEC CICS RETURN END-EXEC.
Write CICS COBOL to write a file

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. CICSWRIT.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-RECORD.
          05 WS-KEY           PIC X(10).
          05 WS-DATA          PIC X(90).
       01 WS-RESP             PIC S9(8) COMP.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE 'NEWKEY001' TO WS-KEY
           MOVE 'NEW CUSTOMER DATA' TO WS-DATA
           EXEC CICS WRITE
               FILE('CUSTFILE')
               FROM(WS-RECORD)
               RIDFLD(WS-KEY)
               RESP(WS-RESP)
           END-EXEC
           IF WS-RESP = DFHRESP(NORMAL)
               EXEC CICS SEND TEXT
                   FROM('RECORD WRITTEN')
               END-EXEC
           END-IF
           EXEC CICS RETURN END-EXEC.
Write CICS COBOL with SEND MAP and RECEIVE MAP

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. CICSMAP.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       COPY CUSTMAP.
       01 WS-COMM-AREA        PIC X(100).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           IF EIBCALEN = 0
               EXEC CICS SEND MAP('CUSTMAP')
                   MAPSET('CUSTSET')
                   ERASE
               END-EXEC
           ELSE
               EXEC CICS RECEIVE MAP('CUSTMAP')
                   MAPSET('CUSTSET')
                   INTO(CUSTMAPI)
               END-EXEC
               PERFORM PROCESS-INPUT
           END-IF
           EXEC CICS RETURN
               TRANSID('CUST')
               COMMAREA(WS-COMM-AREA)
           END-EXEC.
Write CICS COBOL with temporary storage queue

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. CICSTSQ.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-QUEUE-NAME       PIC X(8) VALUE 'MYQUEUE'.
       01 WS-DATA             PIC X(100).
       01 WS-LENGTH           PIC S9(4) COMP VALUE 100.
       01 WS-ITEM             PIC S9(4) COMP.
       01 WS-RESP             PIC S9(8) COMP.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE 'TEST DATA FOR QUEUE' TO WS-DATA
           EXEC CICS WRITEQ TS
               QUEUE(WS-QUEUE-NAME)
               FROM(WS-DATA)
               LENGTH(WS-LENGTH)
               RESP(WS-RESP)
           END-EXEC
           MOVE 1 TO WS-ITEM
           EXEC CICS READQ TS
               QUEUE(WS-QUEUE-NAME)
               INTO(WS-DATA)
               LENGTH(WS-LENGTH)
               ITEM(WS-ITEM)
               RESP(WS-RESP)
           END-EXEC
           EXEC CICS RETURN END-EXEC.
Write CICS COBOL with LINK to another program

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. CICSLINK.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-COMM-AREA.
          05 WS-REQUEST       PIC X(10).
          05 WS-RESPONSE      PIC X(100).
       01 WS-LENGTH           PIC S9(4) COMP VALUE 110.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE 'GETDATA' TO WS-REQUEST
           EXEC CICS LINK
               PROGRAM('SUBPROG1')
               COMMAREA(WS-COMM-AREA)
               LENGTH(WS-LENGTH)
           END-EXEC
           EXEC CICS SEND TEXT
               FROM(WS-RESPONSE)
               LENGTH(100)
           END-EXEC
           EXEC CICS RETURN END-EXEC.
Write CICS COBOL with XCTL

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. CICSXCTL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-COMM-AREA        PIC X(100).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE 'TRANSFER DATA' TO WS-COMM-AREA
           EXEC CICS XCTL
               PROGRAM('NEXTPROG')
               COMMAREA(WS-COMM-AREA)
               LENGTH(100)
           END-EXEC.
Write CICS COBOL with HANDLE CONDITION

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. CICSHNDL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-RECORD           PIC X(100).
       01 WS-KEY              PIC X(10).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           EXEC CICS HANDLE CONDITION
               NOTFND(NOT-FOUND-PARA)
               DUPKEY(DUP-KEY-PARA)
               ERROR(ERROR-PARA)
           END-EXEC
           MOVE 'KEY001' TO WS-KEY
           EXEC CICS READ
               FILE('MYFILE')
               INTO(WS-RECORD)
               RIDFLD(WS-KEY)
           END-EXEC
           EXEC CICS RETURN END-EXEC.
       NOT-FOUND-PARA.
           EXEC CICS SEND TEXT FROM('RECORD NOT FOUND')
           END-EXEC
           EXEC CICS RETURN END-EXEC.
       DUP-KEY-PARA.
           EXEC CICS SEND TEXT FROM('DUPLICATE KEY')
           END-EXEC
           EXEC CICS RETURN END-EXEC.
       ERROR-PARA.
           EXEC CICS SEND TEXT FROM('ERROR OCCURRED')
           END-EXEC
           EXEC CICS RETURN END-EXEC.
Write CICS COBOL with START command for browse

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. CICSBROW.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-RECORD           PIC X(100).
       01 WS-KEY              PIC X(10).
       01 WS-RESP             PIC S9(8) COMP.
       01 WS-EOF              PIC 9 VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE 'A' TO WS-KEY
           EXEC CICS STARTBR
               FILE('CUSTFILE')
               RIDFLD(WS-KEY)
               GTEQ
               RESP(WS-RESP)
           END-EXEC
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF = 1
               EXEC CICS READNEXT
                   FILE('CUSTFILE')
                   INTO(WS-RECORD)
                   RIDFLD(WS-KEY)
                   RESP(WS-RESP)
               END-EXEC
               IF WS-RESP = DFHRESP(ENDFILE)
                   MOVE 1 TO WS-EOF
               ELSE
                   EXEC CICS SEND TEXT
                       FROM(WS-RECORD)
                   END-EXEC
               END-IF
           END-PERFORM
           EXEC CICS ENDBR FILE('CUSTFILE') END-EXEC
           EXEC CICS RETURN END-EXEC.
Write CICS COBOL with ASKTIME and FORMATTIME

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. CICSTIME.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-ABSTIME          PIC S9(15) COMP-3.
       01 WS-DATE             PIC X(10).
       01 WS-TIME             PIC X(8).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           EXEC CICS ASKTIME
               ABSTIME(WS-ABSTIME)
           END-EXEC
           EXEC CICS FORMATTIME
               ABSTIME(WS-ABSTIME)
               MMDDYYYY(WS-DATE)
               DATESEP('/')
               TIME(WS-TIME)
               TIMESEP(':')
           END-EXEC
           EXEC CICS SEND TEXT
               FROM(WS-DATE)
           END-EXEC
           EXEC CICS RETURN END-EXEC.
Write CICS COBOL with REWRITE command

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. CICSRWRT.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-RECORD.
          05 WS-KEY           PIC X(10).
          05 WS-DATA          PIC X(90).
       01 WS-RESP             PIC S9(8) COMP.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE 'KEY001' TO WS-KEY
           EXEC CICS READ
               FILE('CUSTFILE')
               INTO(WS-RECORD)
               RIDFLD(WS-KEY)
               UPDATE
               RESP(WS-RESP)
           END-EXEC
           IF WS-RESP = DFHRESP(NORMAL)
               MOVE 'UPDATED DATA' TO WS-DATA
               EXEC CICS REWRITE
                   FILE('CUSTFILE')
                   FROM(WS-RECORD)
                   RESP(WS-RESP)
               END-EXEC
           END-IF
           EXEC CICS RETURN END-EXEC.
